high_level_description: This image is a promotional graphic for an archetype test designed to explore the diverse facets of male identity. The background is black, which makes the colorful brain illustrations stand out prominently. At the top center, there is bold white text that reads, "HOW RARE IS YOUR MALE ARCHETYPE?" Below this title, there is a paragraph explaining the purpose of the test. It encourages individuals to embrace the various archetypes associated with masculinity, such as The King, The Lover, The Sage, The Warrior, The Magician, The Explorer, The Creator, The Hero, The Caregiver, and The Rebel.
